scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:all
scripts.test:data: pnpm run test:data:node && playwright test tests/data
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:architecture && pnpm run test:data && pnpm run test:behavior && pnpm run test:design
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:behavior && pnpm run test:design
scripts.test:lint-priorities: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern="source CSS does not use important declarations" tests/architecture/repository-policy.test.mjs
